title: Splitting estimate for set integrals
statement: Let X be a type with a measurable space structure and a measure μ, A, B, F ⊆ X measurable sets with A ⊆ B, u, g, t : X → ℝ, G ≥ 0 and C ∈ [0, ∞]. Assume u is μ-integrable on B, ENNReal.ofReal|∫_B u dμ| ≤ C, |u(x)| ≤ G for μ-a.e. x ∈ B, u(x) = 0 for μ-a.e. x ∈ B with x ∉ A and x ∈ F, and |u(x) − g(x)| ≤ G·t(x) for μ-a.e. x ∈ A. Then ENNReal.ofReal|∫_A g dμ| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(G)·(∫⁻_B ENNReal.ofReal(t) dμ + μ(B ∖ F)) + C, where ∫_B u and ∫_A g are Bochner integrals and ∫⁻ is the lower Lebesgue integral.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (A B F : Set X) (u g t : X → ℝ) (G : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → MeasurableSet F → A ⊆ B → 0 ≤ G → IntegrableOn u B μ → ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x in B, u x ∂μ| ≤ C → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ B → |u x| ≤ G) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ B → x ∉ A → x ∈ F → u x = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ A → |u x - g x| ≤ G * t x) → ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x in A, g x ∂μ| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal G * (∫⁻ x in B, ENNReal.ofReal (t x) ∂μ + μ (B \ F)) + C
